role: Fitness-tab 'Sensors' sheet: manage the Polar strap (pair, reconnect, disconnect, stop scan, swipe-to-forget), Stryd/FTMS foot pod or bike trainer, and Concept2 PM5, each as a List section driven by its manager's connection state.
types: SensorManagementSheet: struct View — the sheet; Polar section built inline
FootPodRow: private struct View — status/badge/buttons/discovered list for FootPodManager.shared (via dependencies)
PM5Row: private struct View — same for Concept2Manager.shared
DiscoveredSensorButton: private struct View — one tap-to-pair row for a scanned device
toplevel: No globals. Accessibility identifiers 'sensors.root' (26) and 'sensors.pairStrap' (198) used by UI tests.

flags.text: FootPodRow and PM5Row are line-for-line the same view (status row, badge, state-driven buttons, title/color/badge switches) over two managers sharing BLEPeripheralConnecting; any fix must be made twice.
Polar discoveredDeviceButton re-implements DiscoveredSensorButton (whose doc says it renders a device 'as the Polar list shows it') without its 44pt min height / plain style.
